integrity: Analytical proof with exact hypotheses, separate independently implemented finite numerical tests; no independent audit or claim of publication priority.
scientific_limitations: Two pure tones, positive separation and Gaussian-derivative windows only. For derivative order n>=2, these are not the orthonormal Hermite functions. The mathematical proof addresses ideal exact zeros; no stability or finite observation claim. A possible equivalent formulation in earlier time-frequency interference literature has not been excluded.
title: Cusp unfolding and conserved charge in two-tone Gaussian-derivative spectrogram zeros
